title: SAML metadata sanitation and guided fix wizard
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Build an interactive SAML 2.0 Setup Wizard that automatically sanitizes and normalizes incoming IdP metadata, performs schema and compatibility validation, and produces machine-readable remediation suggestions. The wizard should detect common interoperability problems (missing EntityDescriptor attributes, duplicate AssertionConsumerService endpoints, expired certificates, unsupported NameID formats) and surface safe, reversible fixes the admin can apply from the UI. All actions must be audit-logged with a change diff and operator identity to satisfy upcoming compliance requirements and to integrate with RBAC v2 — only users with the SSO Admin role can apply metadata fixes. The feature will include a deterministic validation report (JSON) for use in CI and a CLI-mode for scripted setups.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard ingests metadata (XML URL or uploaded file) and runs a fast schema + semantic validation pass
System generates a prioritized remediation list with exact patch suggestions (XML diffs) and an estimated risk level for each fix
Operators with SSO Admin role can apply fixes from the UI; non-admins see read-only remediation guidance
Every metadata change emits an audit event with before/after diff, operator, timestamp, and originating IP
A companion CLI can run the same validator and output machine-readable reports (JSON) used by CI
Automated tests cover five common IdP failure modes and a regression suite prevents silent acceptance of dangerous fixes
tasks: Design: UI flow for upload, validation results, edit/preview and apply changes (DES-312)
Backend: Metadata ingestion pipeline with sandboxed XML parsing and schema validation
Backend: Remediation engine that proposes safe XML patches and scores risk
Auth: RBAC v2 guardrails for who can apply fixes; soft-failure for insufficient perms
Audit: structured audit events into central logging (kinesis->s3) and console timeline entries
CLI: implement 'redwood saml validate' with JSON output and exit codes
E2E: staging test harness with three sample IdPs covering shibboleth, ADFS, and generic SAML
Docs: admin runbook and Confluence guide with troubleshooting steps and rollback instructions
QA: fuzz tests for malicious XML and timeouts to ensure parser resilience
prs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5482 - metadata-sanitizer: initial parser and schema checks
test_plan: Unit tests for parser + remediation engine; integration tests validating audit events emitted; staging run against three canonical IdPs using recorded metadata and puppet-driven admin apply. Run CLI validator in CI on each PR and require zero regressions for schema checks. Include mutation tests that corrupt certificates, duplicate ACS endpoints, and strip NameID formats to ensure detection.
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind 'saml_metadata_fix' flag. Phase 1: internal alpha (security + SRE) on staging. Phase 2: opt-in beta for customer admins via console toggle and CLI beta token. Phase 3: globally enabled after 2 weeks of beta with metrics: percentage of applied fixes that required manual rollback < 1% and no unauthorized audit events. Rollback via 'revert metadata' audit action that restores prior entity descriptor. Monitor CPU/parse time and error rates on the ingestion endpoint; throttle uploads if > 10% error flood.
